name: Samuel S. Fisher & Associates CPA, LLC
what_they_do: CPA firm in downtown New Brunswick offering accounting and tax services, with a specialism in attorney trust accounts and litigation support for law firms (IOLA/trust-account compliance and audit readiness), plus business accounting, tax planning/resolution for individuals and small-to-mid-sized businesses.
customers: Law firms (personal injury, real estate, litigation practices) needing trust-account accounting; small and mid-sized businesses, professionals such as doctors, and individual taxpayers in Middlesex County.

size_signals.signal: Suite 311 office at 100 Bayard St with a single main phone line; directory lists two numbers
Offers a ShareFile client portal login, indicating an established small practice with document portal
Only 3 reviews on the Birdeye profile after years in business - inference: one principal plus a small support team with no marketing engine

listing.platform: Birdeye profile (unclaimed) - Google listing not viewed directly

website_review.primary_cta: Phone number at top (not a working link) and 'Read more' links per service
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: None - no scheduling, no quote; only a third-party embedded form and an email-newsletter signup
website_review.trust_signals: Named specialism in attorney trust accounts, 'serving New Jersey' since an established presence, client referrals page, ShareFile secure portal, AICPA-style CPA branding
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Footer reads 'Copyright 2017'; site is a static .html template from NJYP.com; every internal link redirects back to the homepage (so all subpages, including Contact, are unreachable)
website_review.search_basics: One page only; title/description say 'CPA | Middlesex County, NJ' rather than New Brunswick; AccountingService JSON-LD is present and matches the address and phone; no per-service pages because no subpage loads
top_issues: Only the homepage is reachable: /about-us.html, /contact.html, /attorney-services.html, /business-services.html, /service-area.html, /news.html and /articles.html all redirect silently back to '/' - visitors (and crawlers) cannot reach detail, contact or service-area pages at all.
Click-to-call is broken: the header phone number is an anchor with href="732-846-1700" (a relative URL), so tapping it on a phone leads to an error page instead of dialling.
No booking, no quote path, an unclaimed 3-review profile (3.7 stars), 2017 copyright and no hours published anywhere on the site.

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt not checked separately; the site itself is https and returns 200, but every internal URL redirects to the homepage, which is a bigger crawlability problem than robots rules. AccountingService JSON-LD with name, address and telephone is present and accurate, but there are no hours, services list or price ranges, and no booking or working contact form - an agent cannot get past the homepage.

operations_signals.signal: Firm markets attorney trust-account reconciliation and audit defence - recurring, deadline-driven, document-heavy work that needs monthly statement collection.
ShareFile portal is the only client document channel shown; no intake form, no scheduling - inference: scheduling and document chasing happen by phone and email with the principal.
3 Google/Birdeye reviews and an unclaimed profile despite an established practice - inference: no review-request process.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild the site so its pages actually load: working service pages (attorney trust accounting, business, individual), a New Brunswick-targeted title, a real contact/intake form and tel: click-to-call.
top_opportunities.evidence: Every internal link (contact.html, about-us.html, attorney-services.html, service-area.html, news.html, articles.html) redirects to the homepage, and the phone anchor href is a relative '732-846-1700'.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Monthly trust-account document chase: automated client reminders for bank statements/ledgers plus a secure upload link, feeding the existing ShareFile workflow.
top_opportunities.evidence: The firm's lead service is attorney trust-account compliance; the only document channel is a ShareFile login with no reminders or intake visible.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete the Google Business Profile (hours, categories, services, photos) and start review requests to move off 3.7 stars from 3 reviews.
top_opportunities.evidence: Birdeye shows an unclaimed profile with 3 reviews at 3.7; hours appear nowhere on the firm's own site.

scores.reasons: A one-page site whose navigation silently dead-ends plus a broken tap-to-call is about as much missing as a firm can have; a small CPA practice serving law firms can pay modestly and the rebuild is straightforward.
